lines: When something sad happens, I open the leather cover
In the graduation photo, that person has gentle eyes
When I saw you in town, I couldn't say a thing
Because the face from the graduation photo was still there, unchanged
Swept along by the crowd, I keep changing
And sometimes you scold me from far away
Under the swaying willow, as if speaking to me
Even the road I used to walk, now I only see it from the train
Don't forget the way we lived back then
Swept along by the crowd, I keep changing
And sometimes you scold me from far away
